topic: December 2025 AILET Corner: Current Affairs Facts

subtopics.title: Environment, Science and Defence
subtopics.summary: This subtopic covers the CAFE fuel-efficiency norms and their phases, the UNEP Global Environment Outlook (GEO-7) report, and the ISRO launch of BlueBird Block-2. It also covers wetland additions to the Ramsar List and the Majuli river island.
facts: CAFE norms are notified under the Energy Conservation Act, 2001
CAFE objectives: reduce fuel consumption, lower CO2 emissions, curb air pollution and reduce oil import dependency
CAFE phases: Phase I 2017-18, Phase II 2022-23, Phase III 2027-32
UNEP released the 7th Global Environment Outlook (GEO-7), 'A Future We Choose'; HQ in Nairobi
Pollution is linked to 9 million deaths every year
ISRO's LVM3-M6 launched BlueBird Block-2 into Low Earth Orbit on a commercial mission for AST SpaceMobile (USA)
Indian Coast Guard inducted Samudra Pratap, an indigenous pollution control vessel
Majuli: Charaichung Royal Bird Sanctuary was established in 1633 by Ahom ruler Pratap Singha; Majuli is the world's largest river island
Siliserh Lake and Kopra Reservoir were added to the Ramsar List, taking India's total to 96 wetlands

subtopics.title: International Bodies and Conventions
subtopics.summary: This subtopic covers the US-led Pax Silica initiative, from which India is excluded, and SoLAR Phase II for solar irrigation. It also covers the Biological Weapons Convention, the UNESCO education convention, the Kimberley Process chair and the ADB.
facts: Pax Silica is a US-led strategic geo-economic and technology initiative; India is excluded from it
Pax Silica covers the entire silicon value chain, from critical minerals to chips, AI infrastructure and logistics
Pax Silica members: US, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Netherlands, UK, Israel, UAE and Australia
SoLAR (Solar Irrigation for Agricultural Resilience) Phase II covers India, Bangladesh, Kenya and Ethiopia
SoLAR Phase I (2019-2024) was implemented by IWMI (Colombo) and the Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation
Biological Weapons Convention: opened for signature in 1972, entered into force in 1975, 189 member states
Biological Weapons Convention prohibits development, production, stockpiling and use of biological and toxin weapons
UNESCO Convention against Discrimination in Education was adopted in 1960; India has not ratified it
ADB was established in 1966 and is headquartered in Manila; it revised India's FY26 GDP growth forecast to 7.2%
India chairs the Kimberley Process from January 2026 to keep conflict diamonds out of global trade
